changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwchiefcomplain AS SELECT cc.id, cc.patient_id, cc.encounter_id, cc.chief_complaint, cc.provocation, cc.palliation, cc.quality, cc.region, cc.severity, cc.onset_date_time, cc.case_understanding, cc.patient_condition, cc.is_triage, cc.created_by, cc.created_date, cc.last_modified_by, cc.last_modified_date FROM public.chief_complain cc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwchiefcomplain TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwchiefcomplain FROM report_user;
